pcp_order_request.transcript:
Office: Sunrise Family Medicine, this is Maria.
Agent: Hi Maria, this is Mira, an automated care coordinator for Eleanor Martinez. Dr. Chen noted a verbal order for a standard manual wheelchair. We need the signed written order.
Office: I see the note. I'll pass it to Dr. Chen's MA to prep the order. Give us a couple of days.

pcp_order_nudge.transcript:
Office: Sunrise Family Medicine, Maria.
Agent: Following up on Eleanor Martinez's wheelchair order.
Office: Dr. Chen is ready to sign, but she wants a copy of the physical therapy mobility evaluation Mrs. Martinez had at Lakeview Physical Therapy last month in the chart first. We don't have it. It's just the existing records; no new visit or assessment is needed, and Dr. Chen isn't changing the order.

Office: Sunrise Family Medicine, Maria.
Agent: Following up again on Eleanor Martinez's order.
Office: The Lakeview evaluation is in the chart now. Dr. Chen signed the K0001 order this morning and I'm faxing it now.

coordination.transcript: Office: Yes, we received pt-eval-1027, the Lakeview Physical Therapy mobility evaluation for Eleanor Martinez. That is exactly what Dr. Chen needed for the chart; we accept it for this request.

Patient: Okay. I understand what happens next and that I'll owe about twenty percent if they take assignment. No questions, thank you dear.
